tags.name: km-editor
tags.description:
---


### **Events:**
 - **change** - The document changed by the user (typing, toolbar, paste, …), a plugin, or `setValue()` (not `{ isSilent: true }`). Assigning `value` / `contentFormat` is silent, like a native `input.value`, and so is a form reset (like a native `form.reset()`). `detail`: `{ value, contentFormat }` — the content serialized in the active `contentFormat`. Twin: `onChange(detail)`.
- **ready** - The editor was built and is live for the first time (once per element lifetime; core `BlissElement`). Fires right after the first build — during upgrade for a normal element, or when the `defer` gate is released (`el.release()` / removing `defer`). The host then has the `ready` attribute and matches `:state(ready)`; `el.whenReady()` resolves. `detail`: `controller` / `element`. Twin: `onReady(detail)`.
- **view-mode-change** - The view mode was switched by anything but the app's own assignment: a view-mode toolbar item (`source: 'user'`), `setViewMode()` on the element or `controller` (`'api'`, unless `{ isSilent: true }`), or a plugin / pipeline stage through its `setViewMode` port (`'plugin'`). Assigning `viewMode` (attribute `view-mode`) is silent. `detail`: `{ viewMode, oldViewMode, source }`. Twin: `onViewModeChange(detail)`.
- **lock-change** - A gating pipeline (e.g. the cloud-image `image:browser:pick`) locked the editor for its run, or released it. `detail`: `{ isLocked }`. Twin: `onLockChange(detail)`.
- **value-format-error** - A `getValueFormatCallback` threw while formatting the submitted value. The hidden input then carries an empty string and the host is invalid (`customError`, message = label `valueFormatError`), so the form refuses to submit (`<form novalidate>` submits an empty string); the next successful format clears it. `detail`: `{ error, value }` (`value` = the unformatted document in `contentFormat`). Twin: `onValueFormatError(detail)`.
- **action** - A toolbar / selection-toolbar / context-menu item was activated. `detail`: `action` (the command name, or `custom`), `id`, `item`, `source` (`toolbar` | `selection-toolbar` | `context-menu`), `sourceEvent`, `triggerElement`, `dataset`, `state` (the ProseMirror state). Fires after the item’s `onClick` and the command (a notification after the fact; `state` is the snapshot from activation); `beforeActionCallback` → `false` cancels. Keyboard shortcuts do not fire it. Twin: `onAction(detail)`.
- **input-rejected** - Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.

### **Methods:**
 - **formResetCallback(): _void_** - The surrounding `<form>` was reset: restore the initial content (`defaultValue`,
attribute `value`), like a native control — silently: a native `form.reset()`
fires no `input` / `change`, so neither does this (the hidden input is synced).
- **setValue(value: _string_, format: _EditorFormat_, options: _{ isSilent?: boolean }_): _void_** - Replace the document with `value`, parsed in `format` (defaults to the active
`contentFormat`) — the controller's write path. Fires `change` unless
`options.isSilent`; assigning `el.value` is the silent form (like a native
`input.value`). Either way the hidden form input is synced.
- **setViewMode(mode: _EditorViewMode_, options: _{ isSilent?: boolean }_): _void_** - Switch the view mode (`edit` | `split` | `preview` | `inline`). Fires
`view-mode-change` (`source: 'api'`) unless `options.isSilent`; a no-op (no event)
when `mode` is already active, and an invalid mode warns and keeps the current one.
Assigning `el.viewMode` is the silent form.
- **whenReady(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once the first build is live (also settles when the element is destroyed first). Never rejects.
- **release(): _void_** - Build an element held by `defer` (SPEC §6.3), with everything assigned meanwhile.
- **setAttributes(values: _Record<string, unknown>_): _InputRejection[]_** - Apply many inputs (by configKey or attribute name) as ONE rebuild / update. Returns the values it refused (each also fires `input-rejected`).
- **batch(fn: _() => void_): _void_** - Run `fn` and coalesce every input change it makes into one rebuild / update.
- **flush(): _void_** - Apply pending input writes synchronously, now (SPEC §12.7).
- **whenSettled(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once every staged input change has been applied (SPEC §12.7).
- **destroy(): _void_** - Final teardown (SPEC §6.5): the element is inert afterwards; idempotent.
- **enableLogging(level: _LogLevelDesc_): _void_** - Set this element's own log level (default `debug`): it logs that level and above, whatever its component type or the page is set to.
- **disableLogging(): _void_** - Silence this element (its own level = `silent`).
- **resetLogging(): _void_** - Clear this element's own log level: it follows its component type / the page again.
- **checkValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check (SPEC §6.6).
- **reportValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check that reports to the user (SPEC §6.6).

### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--we-radius** - Corner radius of the frame, output panel, inline card and floating panels _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-gap** - Gap between the editor and the live output in split view _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-min-height** - Minimum height of the editor frame and body _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-font-family** - Editor font _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-accent** - Accent: toggled commands (both toolbars), pending loader; --we-selected-outline-color follows it _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-text-on-accent** - Text on the accent fill (toggled commands) — black or white, whichever reads better _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-text-color** - Body text _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-muted-fg** - Muted text: status bar, empty-document placeholder _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-bg** - Editing surface and output panel background; the derived surfaces follow it _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-muted-bg** - Raised strips: zone toolbar, status bar, output tabs, table headers, preview surface _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-hover-bg** - Hover overlay of toolbar commands and output tabs _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-border** - Frame, dividers, group separators, table cell borders, image hover outline _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-danger** - Destructive commands _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-shadow-color** - Shadow tone of the inline card and the floating panels _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-selection-toolbar-bg** - Selection-toolbar pill background — a dark pill in both modes (tooltip tokens) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-selection-toolbar-color** - Selection-toolbar pill text; its hover and separator are mixes of it _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-tooltip-bg** - Toolbar button / status item tooltip background (core createTooltip; the shared tooltip tokens) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-tooltip-color** - Toolbar button / status item tooltip text _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-tooltip-z-index** - Tooltip stacking (core Z_INDEX tooltip tier) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-popover-z-index** - Stacking of the inline-mode card over the page and of the selection toolbar (core Z_INDEX popover tier) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-link-color** - Links in the document _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-link-color-hover** - Hovered links _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-focus-outline** - Keyboard focus ring (:focus-visible) of toolbar / selection-toolbar buttons, output tabs, output panel _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-focus-outline-offset** - Offset of the focus ring outside a button / output tab; the output panel draws it inset by the same amount _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-selected-outline-color** - Outline of a selected node (image, …), selected-cell border, column-resize handle _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-selected-cell-bg** - Selected table cells _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-inline-code-bg** - Inline code background _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-inline-code-color** - Inline code text _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-code-block-bg** - Code block background — the same in both modes on purpose (Prism's dark "tomorrow" highlighting) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-code-block-color** - Code block text — the same in both modes on purpose _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-code-block-label-color** - Code block language label — the same in both modes on purpose _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-code-toolbar-label-color** - Code toolbar label — the same in both modes on purpose _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-disabled-opacity** - Fade of disabled toolbar / selection-toolbar commands _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-loader-icon** - Pending loader glyph (a mask tinted by the accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-loader-rotate** - Pending loader rotation per cycle (0 for a self-animating SVG) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-loader-duration** - Pending loader spin duration _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-loader-size** - Pending loader size _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-z-index** - Context menu: stacking (unset: --km-menu-z-index, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-bg** - Context menu: background (unset: --km-menu-bg, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-text-color** - Context menu: item text (unset: --km-menu-text-color, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-border** - Context menu: border (unset: --km-menu-border, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-border-radius** - Context menu: corner radius (unset: --km-menu-border-radius, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-shadow** - Context menu: shadow (unset: --km-menu-shadow, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-min-width** - Context menu: minimum width (unset: --km-menu-min-width, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-padding** - Context menu: padding (unset: --km-menu-padding, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-font-size** - Context menu: font size (unset: --km-menu-font-size, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-item-padding** - Context menu: item padding (unset: --km-menu-item-padding, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-hover-bg** - Context menu: hovered item background (unset: --km-menu-hover-bg, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-hover-color** - Context menu: hovered item text (unset: --km-menu-hover-color, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-toggled-color** - Context menu: toggled item check / text (unset: --km-menu-toggled-color, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-shortcut-color** - Context menu: shortcut hint text (unset: --km-menu-shortcut-color, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-danger-color** - Context menu: destructive item text (unset: --km-menu-danger-color, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-divider-color** - Context menu: divider (unset: --km-menu-divider-color, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_
- **--we-context-menu-disabled-opacity** - Context menu: disabled item fade (unset: --km-menu-disabled-opacity, then the --base-* theme, then core's default) _(default: undefined)_

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial / default content, interpreted per `contentFormat` (like a native input’s `value` attribute ↔ `defaultValue`). Changing it replaces the document. The live content is the `value` PROPERTY.

attributes.name: content-format
attributes.description: The format of the one document — the lens for content I/O (the `value` attribute and property, the `change` event): 'markdown' (default), 'html', or 'json'. Switching it re-reports the SAME document in the new format — it never rebuilds the document, and (like any assignment) fires no `change`.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. When set, a light-DOM `<input type="hidden" name="…">` child of the host carries the live content (serialized in `contentFormat`) and submits with the surrounding `<form>`; it is disabled (not submitted) while the editor is disabled, including by a `<fieldset disabled>`. A form reset restores `defaultValue` (attribute `value`) silently — no `change`, like a native `form.reset()`.

attributes.name: view-mode
attributes.description: Presentation: 'edit' (default), 'split' (editor + live output), 'preview' (read-only render), or 'inline' (overlay chrome on a live-page element). `preview` forces read-only. Full layouts arrive in Phase 3; for now the view mode is stored and reflected. Assigning it (property or attribute) is silent — no `view-mode-change`; `setViewMode()` and the view-mode toolbar items fire it.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Read-only: the content can’t change (no typing, toolbar hidden), but it stays focusable, selectable and copyable. `view-mode="preview"` also forces this on. Reflects to `readonly`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: no interaction at all — not editable, not focusable or selectable (the surface is `inert`), toolbar hidden. An ancestor `<fieldset disabled>` disables it too (core). Reflects to `disabled`, like a native control.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Required, like a native control: while the document has no content (no text after trimming whitespace and no image, table or other non-text node), the form validity is `valueMissing` (message `errors.required`) and the surrounding `<form>` refuses to submit. The host gets `aria-required` and `:state(required)` (core). Never missing while read-only or disabled. Reflects to `required`.

attributes.name: toolbar
attributes.description: Static toolbar edge: 'top' (default), 'bottom', 'start', or 'end' places the command toolbar flush against that side of the editor; 'none' hides it. The selection toolbar and context menu are always available while editing (independent of this).

attributes.name: statusbar
attributes.description: Status bar edge: 'none' (default), 'top', 'bottom', or 'both'. A dedicated strip of live indicators (word/char count, plus any plugin status items), hugging the editor body — separate from the toolbar zones and shown in read-only too. With 'both', items split across the two strips by their `bar` ('top'/'bottom', default 'bottom').

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: For `view-mode="inline"` only: a CSS selector for the live-page element the floating editor card anchors to (tracked via the core positioning primitive). Absent → the inline card renders in normal flow.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Every UI string (rulebook D-NC-24), a PARTIAL object over built-in English, `{ctx.*}` placeholders (a dynamic text passes its context as `{ ctx }`; `ctx.count` = the number its noun agrees with); an empty string = deliberately empty. Keys are flat `<elementType>.<name>`, short (`tooltips.bold`) or full (`km-editor.tooltips.bold`). `placeholders.document` (default empty = off) is shown while the document is empty. Command items (`<name>` = the camel-cased command id: `bold`, `insertLink`, `viewEdit`): `buttons.<name>` (a toolbar button with text), `ariaLabels.<name>` (an icon toolbar button), `menuItems.<name>` (the context menu), `tooltips.<name>`; toolbar groups `ariaLabels.<groupId>Group` (`ariaLabels.formatGroup`, …); status `labels.words` / `labels.chars` (`{ctx.count}`); prompt titles `headers.linkUrl`, `headers.imageUrl`, `headers.imageAlt`, `headers.codeLanguage` / `headers.codeLanguageChange` (`{ctx.languages}`, `{ctx.language}`); cloud image `ariaLabels.cloudImage`, `tooltips.cloudImage`, `menuItems.cloudImage`, `headers.cloudImagePicker`, `messages.cloudImagePicker`; context menu as a sheet / drawer `buttons.back`, `ariaLabels.close` (also the dialogs' ✕); dialog buttons `buttons.ok`, `buttons.cancel`; split output tabs `buttons.markdownTab`, `buttons.htmlTab`, `buttons.jsonTab` and their tab list `ariaLabels.outputTabs`; `errors.valueFormat`; `errors.required` (a `required` editor left empty); the loader's `ariaLabels.loading`; the editing surface's name `ariaLabels.editor` (when the element has no `aria-labelledby` / `aria-label` / `<label for>`); screen-reader announcements of a view-mode switch `ariaLabels.viewModeEdit`, `ariaLabels.viewModeSplit`, `ariaLabels.viewModePreview`, `ariaLabels.viewModeInline` (an empty string silences one). Per key: these → the page-wide flat `window.components.locale.labels['km-editor.<key>']` → English; the element's own `translateCallback`, then `window.components.locale.translateCallback`, translate the rest. Property (object) or JSON attribute (`labels='{"ariaLabels.bold":"Tučně"}'`). Applies live (no rebuild).

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: BCP-47 locale for the numbers the editor formats — the status-bar word / char counts (`{ctx.count}` in `labels.words` / `labels.chars`: `1234` → `1,234` en / `1.234` de / `1 234` cs) — and the `locale` a `translateCallback` gets; or unset (`'auto'` / empty = unset): the page-wide `window.components.locale.locale`, else the browser language. UI strings are `labels`. Applies live (no rebuild).

attributes.name: custom-styles
attributes.description: CSS injected into the editor's shadow root (a `<style class="we-custom-styles">` after the page-wide `window.components['km-editor'].customStyles` layer, so it overrides it). An `@import`ed font is also linked once in the document `<head>` (core). Raw CSS — never put untrusted input here.

attributes.name: menu-presentation
attributes.description: How the component's context / dropdown menus open: 'auto' (default — a bottom sheet on a phone, the floating menu elsewhere), 'floating', 'sheet' (bottom sheet) or 'drawer' (full-height side panel on `menu-side`). Per device / width through the responsive rules.

attributes.name: menu-side
attributes.description: The edge a 'drawer' menu slides in from: 'start' (default — left in LTR, right in RTL) or 'end'.

attributes.name: defer
attributes.description: Hold the first build (core, SPEC §6.3): while set when the element first connects, nothing is built and every input, callback and listener assigned meanwhile accumulates; `release()` (or removing the attribute) then builds once. Latched after the first build.

attributes.name: theme-source
attributes.description: Where this element reads its theme from instead of the page (core, SPEC §12.10): a CSS selector (nearest matching ancestor, else the first match), `'closest'` (the nearest ancestor carrying a theme signal), or (property only) an `Element`. Unset = the page.

attributes.name: motion
attributes.description: Motion level (core, SPEC §12.16): `auto` (default — inherit: the nearest `data-motion` ancestor (a section), else the page level `window.components.motion` / `<html data-motion>`; closest wins), `none` (no transitions, instant scrolling), `snappy` (short) or `smooth` (longer). Sets the shared `--base-duration-*` / `--base-scroll-behavior` tokens on the element through `data-motion`; the OS reduced-motion setting always wins.

attributes.name: responsive
attributes.description: Instance responsive rules (core, SPEC §6.7): partial configs on three axes — `breakpoint` (keyed by the window-width bucket), `container` (keyed by the component's own width: `narrow` / `medium` / `wide`, lines `--base-container-narrow` / `-medium`, 480 / 768) and `device` (keyed by device class `mobile` / `tablet` / `desktop`; a mouse device is `desktop` at any width), applied in that order (a later axis wins). An object or a JSON attribute, e.g. `{"device":{"tablet":{"presentation":"modal"}},"breakpoint":{"mobile":{…}}}`. Beats page rules (`window.components.responsive*`) and values set on the element; never reflects. An entry of `null` ignores the page rules while it matches.
